subject: Pricing follow-up: committed-use & startup discount options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechapp.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@fintechapp.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing follow-up: committed-use & startup discount options

Hi Alex / Sarah,

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. Quick recap + a few asks so we can put a formal quote together: 

Call recap
- Primary use case: real-time summarization + classification for customer support — high QPS, medium token per request (~250 tokens avg).
- Expected ramp: ~20M tokens/mo for the first 2 months, moving toward ~80M tokens/mo by month 6; potential to reach 300M/mo in year 1 depending on feature rollout.
- Main constraints: predictable unit economics (we need a target $/1M tokens to evaluate ROI) and a limited initial procurement budget.

Pricing asks I have for you
1) Target unit economics: can you share the target $ per 1M tokens you have in mind (ballpark is fine)?
2) Budget range: monthly budget target for the next 6-12 months (helps me map discount tiers).
3) Decision timeline and procurement lead (PO process).

What we can offer (high level)
- Startup program: up to 40% off list for eligible early-stage customers + usage credits in year 1 (needs company size / funding round confirmation).
- Committed-use tiers: 12-month committed commitments (example tiers below):
  - 100M tokens/month commit -> $120 / 1M tokens
  - 300M tokens/month commit -> $95 / 1M tokens
  - 1B tokens / year (aggregate) -> $80 / 1M tokens
- Multi-year incentives: additional 5-10% off for 2+ year commitments (structured as an uplift on committed discounts).

Next steps
- Alex: please confirm target $/1M tokens and monthly budget band.
- I'll prepare a draft quote (include startup eligibility notes) and loop in Aditya (SE) to validate throughput and batching assumptions.
- If you can share a rough traffic schedule (monthly tokens) I'll build a committed-use quote that maps to your ramp.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_deck_v3.pdf (pricing + example committed tiers), draft_quote_FIN-2026-032.xlsx (placeholder numbers).

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechapp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@fintechapp.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed-use & startup discount options

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Target unit economics: ideally looking for ~$150 / 1M tokens to make the feature unit-economically viable at initial volumes.
- Budget range: we can commit to $25k-$40k/mo initially, but can stretch with clear committed discounts and predictable pricing.
- Expected volumes: as you noted, ~20M/mo initial, ramp to 80M/mo in 4-6 months; if the pilot does well we'd push toward 250-300M/mo within 12 months.
- Decision timeline: want to finalize terms within 2-3 weeks; procurement needs a formal quote and PO (Sarah is the owner for procurement).

A few Qs: does the startup program require company size/funding thresholds? Also curious what the effective $/1M looks like after startup credit + 12-month commit vs. pure committed tiers.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Alex
VP Product | FinTechApp
alex@fintechapp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechapp.com>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@fintechapp.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T12:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed-use & startup discount options

Alex — great, that helps a lot. Based on your target $150/1M and $25k-$40k/mo budget, a couple of structured options we should consider (numbers are illustrative; SE to validate efficiency):

Option A — Startup program + low commit (best for minimal ops friction)
- Eligibility: companies < $5M ARR or pre-Series A (we'll need funding round / headcount).
- Offer: 40% off list for first 6 months + $25k usage credit applied month-over-month for first 3 months if you hit the stated ramp milestones.
- Effective price example: list $250/1M -> after 40% = $150/1M (meets your target) while credits cover early months.

Option B — 12-month committed use (predictable cost)
- 100M/mo commit (12mo): effective $120 / 1M tokens.
- 300M/mo commit (12mo): effective $95 / 1M tokens.
- For your forecast (20 -> 80M/mo), we could structure a 12-mo aggregate commit of ~500M for the first year (avg ~42M/mo) and price at ~$100 / 1M, with step-up credits as you hit higher tiers.

Option C — Multi-year (2-year)
- Additional 7-10% off committed tier pricing for multi-year. Example: $95/1M -> $88/1M with 2-year lock and volume guarantees.

I'll run exact math with Aditya on the expected tokenization assumptions and batching benefits (these can materially affect the effective $/1M).

Next for me: build a formal quote with two scenarios (startup credit + low commit vs 12-mo commit) and include a comment about procurement / PO flow. Will attach an updated draft quote.

Thanks — looping Aditya to validate perf assumptions.
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: FIN-2026-032 — pricing check / margin on proposed startup + commit combos

Aditya / Ben — quick internal ask:

Context: FinTechApp wants ~$150/1M target and ~20M->80M ramp, $25k-$40k/mo. We proposed: startup 40% off (6mo) OR 12-mo 500M aggregate -> ~$100/1M. Also flagged multi-year incentives.

Please confirm:
- SE assumptions on tokenization and batching (are we comfortable assuming 250 tokens/req and X avg latency that supports their QPS?)
- Margin at the proposed $100/1M and at a 2-year 10% additional discount (we need to confirm we keep minimum margin for enterprise deals).
- Any operational constraints (SLA on dedicated capacity) if they push to 300M+/mo in year 1.

I'm planning to send a draft quote to Alex tomorrow morning — need a thumbs up or pushback by end of day.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechapp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@fintechapp.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: committed-use & startup discount options

Marissa — thanks, that all looks reasonable. A couple of items before we finalize:

1) Startup eligibility — we are pre-Series A (~$1.8M total funding) and 18 employees. Should qualify, please confirm.
2) Ramp credits — could you show the playbook for credits (how they apply, and any carve-outs)?
3) Flex on multi-year — we prefer a 12-month with an option to extend at the same discounted rate for year 2 (rather than a hard 2-year lock). Is that feasible?

If you can send a formal quote (line-item pricing, term, PO instructions) we'll route to procurement (Sarah) for a quick review. Ideally get this to us before end of week so procurement has time.

Appreciate it — Alex
